claim: TP4 9B demo crash root-caused from the operator-provided worker.out: the engine loaded all 4 ranks successfully (engine ready at 3008.9s, weight load 2765s), then generate() died with ValueError: The input (19 tokens) is longer than the model context length (16 tokens). The demo_gen.py worker had pinned context_length=16 and max_total_tokens=16 (copied from the accepted 2-token-prompt lane configuration), but the operator prompt is 19 tokens. Fixed: context_length=512, max_total_tokens=256 — fits the 19-token prompt plus the 20 output tokens with headroom. Environment cleaned of all hanging processes (gem5/sglang/firecracker all zeroed) before the fix.
root_cause: context_length=16 hardcoded from lane config; operator prompt is 19 tokens
